summary: The note describes the early answering machine, using the Tel-Magnet as its example. It was offered in the United States in 1949 and could play outgoing messages while recording incoming ones onto magnetic wire. Priced at $200, the device was not a commercial success.
one_line: Overview of the early answering machine, exemplified by the 1949 US Tel-Magnet that recorded messages on magnetic wire.
key_facts: A commercial answering machine called the Tel-Magnet was offered in the United States in 1949.
The Tel-Magnet recorded incoming messages on a magnetic wire.
The Tel-Magnet was not a commercial success.
